name: ShieldLint
description: Offline privacy linter for Zcash — catches transparent recipients, memo/viewing-key leaks and invalid ZIP 316/321 addresses before they ship.

paragraphs: Offline privacy linting for Zcash software. Point it at a repository; it reads every address, viewing key and zcash: payment request it can find and tells you where the integration leaks money-flow metadata — before the code ships.
Built for ZECATHON 2026 — Core & Tooling track. MIT licensed, zero runtime dependencies, no network access, no keys touched.
Try it in the browser → — scan a file, decode an address, validate a payment request. Same engine, no install.
